firm_data.firm_description: Miller Zeiderman LLP is a New York City and Westchester County family law firm providing personalized representation in divorce, child custody, and other family law matters. They have over 100 years of combined experience practicing family law in New York.
notable_facts: The firm has locations in New York City, White Plains, and Nassau County.
The firm's attorneys have established relationships with legal professionals in New York City and Westchester County.

email.subject: AI for Miller Zeiderman LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Faith,

With three offices across New York City, White Plains, and Nassau County, Miller Zeiderman is handling complex custody and divorce matters across multiple jurisdictions, which means your team is managing significant case complexity with precision work that can't scale easily.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding regionally. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with larger competitors on turnaround time and quality.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
